scope: Proposition 5.2 of the manuscript “A counterexample to the nearby Lagrangian conjecture” (preprints/A-counterexample-to-the-nearby-Lagrangian-conjecture-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 340 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ce7a208ddd7ef666), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 18. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: On Q = B × SN−1 there is a smooth Morse family F : Q × RN → R which equals gb(w) outside a uniform vertical ball and whose generating map is a diffeomorphism from its critical locus onto a closed exact embedded Lagrangian L ⊂ T∗Q. Its critical locus, and hence L, is diffeomorphic to Q. The infinity class on each slice B × {v0} is the chosen class a.
